name: Coll_SegmentVsMesh
signature: uint __cdecl (float sx,sy,sz, float ex,ey,ez, int* mesh)

name: Coll_SphereVsMesh
signature: uint __cdecl (float x,y,z, float r, int* mesh)
notes: Plane projection inside the quad (normal = plane), else nearest point of the first failing edge / its end points (normal = centre - point); 0x009CAC4C = plane value; nearest wins
